text:
Ava Morgan: dropping a quick review for the latency card iteration in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-latency/card-v4 — want to lock down p95 behaviour on small widths :eyes:
Ravi Patel: skimmed it. main issue: the p95 pill collides with the scrubber handle between 2m-5m ranges
Casey O'Neill: idea: replace the pill with a small glyph (bars) + numeric tooltip on hover/tap. keep full text on >= 480px
Jun Park: glyph needs an accessible name. propose aria-label="95th percentile latency" and tooltip reads e.g. "p95: 312ms"
Ava Morgan: agreed. also noticed heatmap buckets look like 'holes' when sampling is 10% — users think data missing
Ravi Patel: can we add a light diagonal hatch for low-sample buckets and a microcopy state that says "sparsely sampled"?
Casey O'Neill: microcopy suggestion under the heatmap: "Sparsely sampled — results may be noisy. Adjust sampling scope." link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/sampling
Accessibility Bot: Snapshot saved (1725523140) — will include alt text for heatmap and glyph states
Jun Park: keyboard flow bug: when opening time picker, tab order lands on glyph after calendar instead of Apply — breaks expectations
Ava Morgan: repro steps pls?
Jun Park: 1) TAB to range, 2) open picker, 3) TAB through presets -> focus jumps to tooltip-glyph then Apply. Expected linear left-to-right across controls
Ravi Patel: filed UX-3456: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-3456 for focus order fix
Casey O'Neill: small CSS for glyph mode (non-hidden semantics):

```
.p95-glyph { width: 18px; height:18px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.p95-glyph .visually-hidden { position:absolute; left:-9999px; }
```
But prefer aria-label instead of visually-hidden text per a11y team
Ava Morgan: decision summary: desktop/tablet shows "p95 312ms"; collapse to glyph with aria-label="95th percentile latency (p95)" under 480px; heatmap shows diagonal hatch for buckets with sampleRate < 20% plus microcopy "Sparsely sampled — adjust Sampling mode"; update Sampling copy from "Show samples" to "Sampling mode" with default "Auto (recommended)"; fix timepicker tab order (UX-3456). I'll update the mock and hand off to Eng tomorrow :thumbsup:
